name: Single-Pass Rasterization with Alpha-Blending
definition: A rendering pipeline that rasterizes both 3D Gaussians and triangles in a single pass using alpha-blending, ensuring correct spatial occlusion and color blending without dropping rendering rates.
summary: Single-Pass Rasterization with Alpha-Blending unifies 3D Gaussians and triangle meshes in one depth-sorted pass, preventing color overflow by treating depth-adjacent triangles as a single entity.
